channel.title: Wire — AI
channel.description: AI from thirty sources, one digest a day.

item.title: OpenAI GPT-6.1 Terra is now generally available on Amazon Bedrock
item.description: Today, AWS announces the general availability of OpenAI GPT-6.1 Terra on Amazon Bedrock. GPT-6.1 Terra expands the GPT-6 family with a balance of capability, speed, and cost efficiency for everyday workloads. (2 sources: aws, hackernews)

item.title: The Mythical Man-Month in the Age of AI
item.description: An update to Brooks's Law in the age of AI. (1 source: hackernews)

item.title: Concerning behavior from a popular open-weight AI model
item.description: Discover how untrusted open-weight AI models can potentially leak data, even when self-hosted. Learn the security risks and how to protect your enterprise. (1 source: hackernews)

item.title: How Anthropic Redesigned Source Control for AI-Driven Development
item.description: Anthropic recently detailed how it migrated its monorepo from Git to Scion. Scion is a source control system that moves repository operations to the server side and uses content-addressed storage and tiered caches for agent and CI… (1 source: infoq)

item.title: Presentation: Serving LLMs at Scale: The Hidden KV Cache Advantage
item.description: Khawaja Shams shares a distributed systems perspective on scaling LLM inference stacks efficiently. (1 source: infoq)

item.title: AWS Shows Use of AI Agents to Triage Linux Kernel CVEs
item.description: Engineers from Amazon Web Services (AWS) have described how the team that maintains the Linux kernel for EC2 infrastructure handles kernel CVEs. The process combines an automated filter, an AI agent and human review. (1 source: infoq)

item.title: Cloudflare and VoidZero Introduce tsrs: An AI-Generated Rust Port of TypeScript
item.description: Cloudflare, VoidZero and Max Schwenk announced tsrs, an experimental Rust port of the TypeScript compiler, built with the TypeScript team's involvement. (1 source: infoq)

item.title: Import AI 478: Math for alignment; ProgramBench; and Mirendil shows what RSI means
item.description: Welcome to Import AI, a newsletter about AI research. Import AI runs on arXiv, cappuccinos, and feedback from readers. If you’d like to support this, please subscribe. (1 source: importai)

item.title: Developers Reporting Double-Digit Weekly Time Savings From AI Fell From 68% to 26%
item.description: Atlassian’s State of Developer Experience 2026 finds the share of developers saving ten or more hours a week with AI dropped from 68% to 26% year over year, while only 28% report noticeably less friction than before AI. (1 source: infoq)

item.title: AGNTCon + MCPCon 2026: Agentic AI Foundation Adds Four Projects as MCP Turns to Security
item.description: At AGNTCon + MCPCon North America 2026, the Agentic AI Foundation added OpenSandbox, Open Responses, Agent Skills, and OpenEnv, reaching ten projects in its first year. (1 source: infoq)

item.title: BrowserCode: a browser-based coding playground, powered by WebAssembly
item.description: BrowserCode is a development environment that runs entirely client-side, where you can fast prototype and share your running projects instantly. (1 source: rprogramming)
